card.name: Start of encyclopedia-style definitions
card.fires_on: Words right after the subject of an encyclopedia-style definition, such as 'is a', 'was the', or the period ending the first definitional sentence. Seen in general web reference text, not drug labels.

modes.label: Article after 'is/was'
modes.description: The article 'a', 'an' or 'the' right after 'X is/was' that opens a definition.
modes.example: Shapeshifter is<< a>> generic and generalized term applied to lifeforms

modes.label: End of first definition
modes.description: The period or comma that closes the opening definitional sentence or acronym.
modes.example: Women’s Trade Union League (WTUL)Article Free Pass Women’s Trade Union League (WTUL<<),>> American organization, the first national association dedicated

card.plain: It fires at the point in a reference-style entry where the opening definition of a subject begins or ends.
